codes.title: Current Fee Data
codes.text: This estimate uses fee data from EnerGov. Current assessed charges may differ.

codes.title: Estimate Only
codes.text: This is an estimate, not an invoice or a guarantee of final charges.

codes.title: Fee Data Date
codes.text: Fees and calculation rules may have changed after the date shown with the estimate.

codes.title: Past Permit Records
codes.text: Past records show what appeared on similar permits. They do not determine whether a fee or related permit is required.

codes.title: Limited History
codes.text: The historical sample is small, so the observed occurrence rate may not be representative.

codes.title: More Project Information Needed
codes.text: This fee cannot be calculated until the required project information is entered.

codes.title: Staff Review Needed
codes.text: Staff must review project information or make a decision before this fee can be determined.

codes.title: Staff Calculation Needed
codes.text: The tool cannot calculate this fee. No amount is included.

codes.title: Fee May Apply Later
codes.text: This fee may apply only if a later event occurs, such as a failed inspection or reinspection.

codes.title: Fee May Be Charged More Than Once
codes.text: This fee may be charged again if the event occurs again.

codes.title: Possible Related Permit
codes.text: Whether this related permit is needed depends on project type and scope.

codes.title: May Be Identified During Review
codes.text: The need for this related permit may be determined during plan or permit review.
